author: DTrim99
body:
Thanks Dan — confirmed, and it's the same root cause as #1120: PolicyEngine's Montana model was missing the unemployment compensation exemption (Subtractions Schedule, line 7; your cited p. 15 instruction, statutory basis former § 15-30-2110, MCA, repealed by SB 399 effective tax year 2024).

We've already filed [PolicyEngine/policyengine-us#9211](https://github.com/PolicyEngine/policyengine-us/issues/9211) and opened the fix as [PolicyEngine/policyengine-us#9212](https://github.com/PolicyEngine/policyengine-us/pull/9212). Running this record through the patched model:

| Quantity | TaxAct | PE current | PE with fix |
|---|---|---|---|
| Subtractions line 7 (unemployment) | 50,823 | 0 | 50,823.20 |
| Montana AGI | 310 | 51,132.93 | 309.73 |
| Standard deduction | — | 4,830 | 2,140 (single minimum) |
| Taxable income | — | 43,722.93 | 0 |
| siitax | — | 1,167.68 (2,417.68 tax − 1,250 HB 192 rebate) | **0** |

(Only the Subtractions Schedule page shows amounts in the upload, but with zero taxable income there's nothing left to disagree about.)

Ready-to-run input row:

```
taxsimid,year,state,mstat,page,sage,depx,pwages,psemp,swages,ssemp,dividends,intrec,stcg,ltcg,otherprop,nonprop,pensions,gssi,pui,sui,transfers,rentpaid,proptax,otheritem,childcare,mortgage,scorp,idtl,opt1,opt1v
4467327,2021,27,1,53,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,309.73099,0,0,0,0,0,0,50823.199,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,5,30,1
```
